valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pb_withheld_reason: Withheld: the P/B computed from the inputs on file (0.01) is not a valuation for a real business. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the two P/E routes disagree (market cap over net profit 0.02 against price over EPS 17.95) and the filing does not settle which row is right. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.ps_withheld_reason: Withheld: the P/S computed from the inputs on file is 0.0000 because the revenue row is not a revenue for this issuer - a denominator that large collapses the ratio to zero, which reads as a real valuation of nothing. A blank is honest; a zero divided into a market cap is not a valuation.
valuation.peg_withheld_reason: Withheld: the P/E a PEG divides is itself withheld, so there is no P/E to divide by the growth rate. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.earnings_yield_withheld_reason: Withheld: the earnings behind the earnings yield are not verified: the two P/E routes disagree (market cap over net profit 0.02 against price over EPS 17.95) and the filing does not settle which row is right. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2025, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.

derived.enterpriseValueBasis: market cap + borrowings - cash, both from the balance sheet for FY2025
derived.ytdBasis: year to date from the last close before 2026 (2025-12-31, 240.11) to the price on 2026-10-05
